title: feat(hub): carry the package pin when rotating a tarball-sourced deployment
body:
Third step of provisioning the GitHub tool as a versioned package. The hub's rotation copies a deployment from its stored source; for a tarball-sourced deployment that is not enough, because every workflow shares one package-registry asset and the launch spec does not store the pin.

- `pinOf(closure)` reads the pin back from the frozen closure's single top-level entry as `name@version`, which Interchange guarantees exists on both deploy arms. The copy is pinned to the exact version the original resolved, by design.
- A tarball rotation passes that pin and the workflow's own definition asset, looked up from the run's definition row, instead of the shared registry asset. Source-arm rotations are unchanged.
- `sameSource` also compares the pin, so two workflows in the same registry asset are never adopted as the same deployment.

Verified: `bun run check`; hub tests (155) against Postgres, including `pinOf` on a root entry and an empty closure, a tarball rotation carrying pin and definition asset, and a differing pin not matching. Review checked field names against the vendored deploy service and the closure guarantees against the sidecar's apply code.

Refs CL-XXXX
